QuestInfo.name: First Material for Building a New House
QuestInfo.0: Go meet Ronnie in the woods in Ellinia.
QuestInfo.1: Ronnie from the forest of Ellinia asked you to gather up materials to build a house for newborn fairies. #b50 of each of the following: Orange Mushroom Caps, Leaves, Squishy Liquid, and Red Snail Shells#k. You can get most of these from the monsters around the prairie.
QuestInfo.2: You got all the items Ronnie requested, but when do you get rewarded for this? What? How many more times do you have to do this?

0.0: Oh... You are the one who returned the book to my dad! Ah... My dad... He doesn't worry about me... The only thing he cares is that stupid book... Isn't that right?
0.1: You look much stronger than the last time I saw you. Can you do me a favor? I got a request from a fairy in Ellinia. There are many young fairies that need houses. Can you collect some materials so we can build them houses?

yes.0: Really? Thanks! First, can you collect some #b#t4000001#s, #Leaves#, #t4000004#s, and #t4000016#s? say, 50 of each? Those materials come from very weak monster, so it won't be that hard. But this is just the start.

no.0: If you change your mind, please let me know... I can't do this on my own...

1.0: Wow... You have collected them all! Isn't it fun to hunt weak monsters? No? Oh, come on! Anyway I will give these to the fairies, but they still need a lot more materials.

yes.0: There's still so much more to do! If you ever have a spare moment, let me know!

item.0: I don't think you have collected 50 of each of the following: #b#t4000001#, #t4000005#, #t4000004#, #t4000016##k. But cheer up! If you help me, I will give something good. I promise.
